title: Boolean-output tester from a binary-field tester
statement: Given a type $\Omega$, a natural number $r$, and a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$, define a tester from $\Omega$ to the Booleans. It keeps the same random seeds, seed distribution, and queries, converting each answered binary-field value to its corresponding Boolean value before applying the original acceptance rule.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester from $\Omega$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
